scope: Diseases, symptoms, basic/normal care, warning signs and when-to-seek-medical-attention material for a focused medical RAG MVP. Small curated document set only - no PMC, UMLS, SNOMED CT or PrimeKG in this phase.

sources.name: MedlinePlus Health Topics (NLM)
sources.authority: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM), National Institutes of Health (NIH), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
sources.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work); attribution to MedlinePlus.gov requested
sources.license_notes: MedlinePlus health-topic summaries in the XML are free to download and use; MedlinePlus asks that users indicate the information is from MedlinePlus.gov (see NLM API guidance). Some linked/embedded third-party content such as A.D.A.M. articles is copyrighted - exclude that content from the corpus.

documents.title: MedlinePlus Health Topic XML
documents.topic: All English health topics - diseases, symptoms, tests, treatments and wellness (curated topic subset selected below)
documents.selection_reason: Primary global plain-language corpus: each <health-topic> record carries a title, URL, date-created, also-called synonyms and a full summary covering symptoms, care and when to see a doctor.
documents.notes: Published daily Tuesday-Saturday; file name is date-stamped (mplus_topics_YYYY-MM-DD.xml). 2033 records on 2026-10-07 of which 1017 are language="English". Resolve the date-stamped URL from the XML landing page at fetch time.

sources.name: ICMR Guidelines
sources.authority: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.license: Copyright ICMR / Government of India - official clinical and treatment guidelines
sources.license_notes: Government-issued guidelines for non-commercial research and education with clear attribution. Verify ICMR website terms before redistribution or any commercial use.

documents.title: Guidelines for Management of Type 2 Diabetes
documents.topic: Type 2 diabetes mellitus - diagnosis, self-care, glycaemic control and complications
documents.selection_reason: Indian disease-management guideline with plain sections on day-to-day care, warning signs of complications and referral.
documents.notes: 82 pages, text-extractable. Publication year 2018 (from document file name on the ICMR guidelines page).

documents.title: Treatment Guidelines for Antimicrobial Use in Common Syndromes (2nd edition)
documents.topic: Common infectious syndromes - fever, respiratory, diarrhoea, skin and other syndromes; antimicrobial use
documents.selection_reason: Maps presenting symptoms (fever, cough, diarrhoea) to Indian first-line treatment and escalation criteria.
documents.notes: 206 pages, text-extractable. Listed on the ICMR guidelines page under Antimicrobial Resistance.

documents.title: DHR-ICMR Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management of Rickettsial Diseases in India
documents.topic: Rickettsial diseases - fever, rash, early recognition and treatment in India
documents.selection_reason: Indian guideline for a commonly missed cause of fever with rash, including warning signs for severe disease.
documents.notes: 20 pages, text-extractable. Cover dated 2015 (Department of Health Research / ICMR).

documents.title: Guiding Drug Policy for P. falciparum Malaria in the North Eastern States (ICMR-NIMR)
documents.topic: Plasmodium falciparum malaria - antimalarial drug policy for North Eastern India
documents.selection_reason: Short, India-specific malaria treatment policy that complements the general malaria material from MedlinePlus and MoHFW.
documents.notes: No publication date stated in the document; published_at left null.

sources.name: MoHFW Clinical Establishments - Standard Treatment Guidelines
sources.authority: Directorate General of Health Services / National Council for Clinical Establishments, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.license: Government of India (MoHFW / DGHS) - Standard Treatment Guidelines
sources.license_notes: Official STGs published under the Clinical Establishments (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2010. Reproduce with attribution for non-commercial educational or research use; check MoHFW / Clinical Establishments portal terms before redistribution.

documents.title: Standard Treatment Guidelines: Hypertension - Screening, Diagnosis, Assessment and Management of Primary Hypertension in Adults in India (full document)
documents.topic: Primary hypertension in adults - screening, diagnosis, management, referral
documents.selection_reason: Indian standard of care for a high-prevalence condition, including BP thresholds and escalation to seek medical attention.
documents.notes: 144 pages, text-extractable. Cover reads 'Background Document ... March 2016'.

documents.title: Standard Treatment Guidelines: Hypertension Quick Reference Guide
documents.topic: Primary hypertension in adults - quick reference: thresholds, treatment steps, follow-up
documents.selection_reason: Condensed companion to the full hypertension STG; short, high-signal chunks for answer grounding.

documents.title: Standard Treatment Guidelines: Snakebite (full document)
documents.topic: Snakebite envenomation - first aid, anti-snake venom, complications, referral
documents.selection_reason: Indian emergency-care guideline covering first aid, warning signs and hospital care for a major rural emergency.

documents.title: Standard Treatment Guidelines: Management of Snake Bite - Quick Reference Guide
documents.topic: Snakebite - quick reference: first aid do's and don'ts, severity, ASV administration
documents.selection_reason: Short actionable reference for warning signs and immediate care after a snakebite.

documents.title: Standard Treatment Guidelines: Major Trauma (full document)
documents.topic: Major trauma - primary survey, bleeding, airway, when to escalate to emergency care
documents.selection_reason: Covers red-flag warning signs and immediate care steps for injuries; supports 'when to seek medical attention' answers.
documents.notes: 84 pages, text-extractable. No publication date on the cover; published_at left null.

documents.title: Standard Treatment Guidelines: Management of Common Respiratory Infections in Children in India - Quick Reference Guide
documents.topic: Acute respiratory infections in children - classification, home care, danger signs, referral
documents.selection_reason: Child-focused basic care and danger-sign guidance for cough, cold and fast breathing - a core MVP symptom area.

documents.title: National Guidelines on Rabies Prophylaxis
documents.topic: Rabies - animal bite wound first aid, post-exposure prophylaxis, vaccination schedule
documents.selection_reason: Text-extractable Indian guideline with immediate home-care steps for bites and clear advice on seeking care.
documents.notes: 17 pages, text-extractable. No publication date on the cover; published_at left null. The larger NCDC-hosted rabies PDF (image-only scan) was rejected because its text cannot be extracted reliably.

sources.name: NCDC Resource Library
sources.authority: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Directorate General of Health Services, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.license: Government of India (NCDC / MoHFW) - public health guidelines, advisories and patient material
sources.license_notes: Official NCDC resource-library material for non-commercial public-health and educational use with attribution. Verify NCDC / MoHFW terms and conditions before redistribution.

documents.title: National Guidelines on Diagnosis, Case Management, Prevention and Control of Leptospirosis
documents.topic: Leptospirosis - symptoms, clinical presentation, case definitions, treatment, prevention
documents.selection_reason: India-specific infectious-disease guideline for a monsoon-season fever, including severe-disease warning signs and public prevention advice.
documents.notes: 18 pages, text-extractable. Opens with a public prevention flyer, then the full guideline. Document and NCDC imprint dated 2015.

documents.title: NPCCHH Public Health Advisory: Extreme Heat / Heatwave
documents.topic: Heatwave and extreme heat - prevention do's and don'ts, hydration, who is at risk
documents.selection_reason: Short public-facing advisory directly serving the 'basic care and warning signs' scope for a climate-related health risk common in India.

documents.title: Emergency Cooling for Severe Heat Related Illnesses
documents.topic: Severe heat-related illness (heat stroke) - emergency cooling steps and when to get emergency care
documents.selection_reason: Actionable emergency-care guidance with explicit red flags for severe heat illness.

documents.title: Hypertension - Frequently Asked Questions for the General Public
documents.topic: High blood pressure - what it is, causes, risks, prevention and when to seek care
documents.selection_reason: Plain-language Indian patient FAQ that answers common symptom and self-care questions directly.
documents.notes: 11 pages, text-extractable. No publication date stated; published_at left null.
